handoff.salientSummary: Built the App Guest Messages settings, resend and rotate buttons, recorded-client display, Waitlist screen, Waitlist settings, Today waitlist card and floor drag-to-seat, plus the Sites waitlist page, notify-me form and area labels on time chips. Typecheck, unit tests, lint and Lingui checks pass. Most flows were checked in agent-browser on acme. The Playwright spec, riyadh-grill checks, Arabic Sites chip checks and a real-mouse floor drag were not done. Committed as e5c6e296.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: App: settings.messages.tsx with its components, client and view helpers (kind switches, reminder/reconfirm hours, quiet hours, SMS toggle with a KSA email-only note, EN/AR notes, sandboxed-iframe preview, expectedVersion saves with 409 rebase). Detail sheet: Resend confirmation, Rotate manage link behind an AlertDialog, and the recorded X-Client badge. waitlist.tsx (5 s polling, add party with live quote and Idempotency-Key, notify with deadline countdown, seat, edit, status changes, reorder with up/down buttons that persist, 409 handling), settings.waitlist.tsx, a Today waitlist card, and a floor.tsx waitlist panel (drag card onto a table, 'Seat at' keyboard alternative, overbook prompt). settings.tsx gained Guest Messages and Waitlist tabs, and special-days defaults to the service-day business date. Sites: /reserve/waitlist join and status, notify-me form, Join waitlist link, seating-area labels on time chips, and translations in all six locales. Arabic strings were added for the App. During browser checks I fixed two bugs: the App client called the waitlist list and create routes with a trailing slash, which returned 404, and the Sites join and notify-me bodies sent turnstileToken null, which the backend rejected with 400.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: No new Playwright e2e spec was written or run. Not browser-checked: riyadh-grill (KSA) flows, the Sites notify-me form UI end to end (only the endpoint was checked with curl), the Sites time-zone note, and RTL rendering of the App waitlist screen (only the settings screen was seen in Arabic). A real mouse drag onto a floor table did not fire in headless Chrome, so floor drop-to-seat was checked with synthetic DragEvents on the real page (seat POST returned 200). Notification settings (settings+/notifications) were verified by tests only and needed no change. VAL-MSG-027 and VAL-MSG-028 are backend assertions and were not re-run here.

discoveredIssues.description: The tenant-api waitlist list and create routes only match /operator/reservations/book/waitlist without a trailing slash, but the validation contract writes the path with a trailing slash (VAL-WAIT-002 and others). Validators must use the slashless path.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Update the contract text, or add strict:false handling for the waitlist sub-router.

discoveredIssues.description: The @repo/reservations waitlist Zod schemas, status enum and error codes differ from what tenant-api returns. The App waitlist client uses the real contract instead.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Align the package schemas with the route responses.

discoveredIssues.description: The Sites slot data has areaId but hold and book calls take no area from the slot, so the area label on a chip is display only.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Send slot.areaId as areaPref when holding if guests should choose an area.

discoveredIssues.description: The waitlist seat endpoint accepts only table ids and an overbook flag, so a drop on an occupied table offers seat anyway or cancel, not swap or move as VAL-WAIT-019 describes.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Decide whether the contract wording should change or the endpoint should gain swap and move.

deviations.whatIDidInstead: Delegated the Sites, App messages and App waitlist work to three parallel subagents with no browser or typecheck, then did Lingui extraction, Arabic fill, typecheck, lint and browser verification myself.
deviations.why: The scope was large and shared RAM and ports made parallel verification unsafe.

deviations.whatIDidInstead: Did not write or run an e2e spec.
deviations.why: Browser verification surfaced and fixed two integration bugs, and the session ran out of budget for the spec.

suggestedChanges: Tell workers the real tenant-api paths have no trailing slash for sub-router roots.
Note that agent-browser mouse drag does not trigger HTML5 DnD, so synthetic DragEvents are needed for floor drop checks.
